For termination without cause, we propose three months of Base Salary paid through regular payroll, with benefits governed by the applicable plans and law and payment conditioned on an effective release of claims; we can accept the non-compete as currently drafted, subject to applicable law.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. Subject to Vireo’s approval, the Executive shall receive a Base Salary of $250,000 per year, paid in regular payroll installments; benefits under Vireo’s applicable plans, subject to their terms; and eligibility for a discretionary annual bonus of up to 20% of Base Salary.

3. SEVERANCE. If Vireo terminates the Executive’s employment without cause, the Executive shall receive an amount equal to three months of Base Salary, paid through regular payroll, conditioned on the Executive’s execution of a release of claims that becomes effective. Benefits following termination shall be governed by the applicable plans and law.
